title: Parmesan-Crusted Salmon with Roast Fennel, Potatoes & Dill Yogurt
description: Salmon under a crisp Parmesan-lemon crust, roasted on a tray with baby potatoes, fennel and cherry tomatoes, with a lemon-dill yogurt. Garlic-free.

steps.title: Roast potatoes and fennel at 210 °C
steps.text: Heat the oven to 210 °C (fan). Toss the potatoes and fennel on a large tray with the olive oil and ½ tsp salt. Roast 20 min.

steps.title: Make the crust
steps.text: Meanwhile, mix the panko, Parmesan, lemon zest and parsley. Pat the salmon dry, season lightly with salt, spread the top thinly with the Dijon and press the crumb mix on.

steps.title: Add salmon and tomatoes
steps.text: Turn the potatoes, add the cherry tomatoes, nestle the salmon among the veg and roast 12–14 min until the crust is golden and the salmon flakes easily.

steps.title: Make the dill yogurt
steps.text: Stir together the yogurt, dill, 1 tbsp lemon juice and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Plate and split
steps.text: Salmon about 360 g / 150 g raw (Matthias / Nyuszika); potatoes about 400 g / 130 g; fennel and tomatoes about 60/40; dill yogurt 100 g / 30 g. Squeeze the remaining lemon over.

notes: The dill yogurt is the protein bridge on Matthias's plate. If there's no fennel, use 1 large leek cut into 3 cm pieces.
